section.para: Some segments contain only a number: a count, a price, a date or a time. You do not have to fill them in by hand. This window finds such segments and writes the number the way the target language writes it.

listitem.para: Choose the number types to look for: integer, decimal, percent, currency, date, time or ordinal. If you want, set the formatting of the result (thousands separator, decimals, date style). The default keeps the form of the original.
Choose where to look: the whole project, the current file, or the current filter. Segments that already have a translation are only included if you say so.
Click Scan. Every hit appears in the table with its original text, a preview of the result, and a confidence value. Hover over a row to see what raised or lowered the confidence.
Check the rows you want to apply. Rows at or above the confidence threshold are already checked for you.

section.para: The filled-in segments are marked as automatic conversions: they get their own marker color, and the command that jumps to the next untranslated segment skips them.
Double-click a row to open that segment in the editor. The Filter button shows only the hits of the last scan in the editor.
